title: A cost on a range boundary is priced by the range that holds it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 with Default Markup % 50 and from $100.01 with Default Markup % 20.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 100.01 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • At $100.00 Default reads $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00, first range).

Step 3:

  • Default reads $120.01 and "$20.00 profit" ($100.01 × 1.20 = $120.012, rounded to $120.01, second range).
